digest.component_or_area: automated bug filing and deduplication infrastructure
propositions: Automated bug filers lack stable deduplication keys, causing duplicate tickets for the same underlying issue and silent failures when create arguments or gates change.

Three existing auto-filers (heartbeat-alert, binding-drift-alert, conflict-bug-ticket) have no consistent contract for templated body, abort-if-empty-detail, or detected_by stamping, and no threshold to prevent filing on single flakes.
The heartbeat-filer can determine red/green state via workflow run history but currently files without a consecutive-red threshold, causing flakes to create tickets unnecessarily.
The binding-drift-filer observes persistent state (not transient flakes) and already deduplicates via daily accumulation, but lacks a templated body contract and detected_by marking.
The conflict-filer has no dedup key, no template, and no abort-if-empty behavior, causing hollow tickets and unbounded spam on persistent conflicts.
The bug-creation contract (dedup search command, rebar create args, exit codes, detected_by env var) is not documented, leading to inconsistent and fragile automated filing.
